title: The 1995-96 official statement that the remote viewing program never produced useful intelligence

tellings.quote: I think 96 was like this dine thing where they came out and said like, "Oh, it's uh it's not re like it's real, but like we had this program

plain: Around 1995 or 1996, the US government is said to have come out and admitted it had run a remote viewing programme, a project that trained people to try to describe distant places and targets using only their minds, while saying it never produced useful intelligence. Chris Ramsay, a guest who looks into these subjects, recalls it loosely and without a source, putting it as officials saying in effect "we had this program". The point is that the government admitted the programme existed even as it played down what it achieved.
